key_insight: A single, closed-loop framework that pairs a forward predictive model with an inverse generative model efficiently proposes high-conductivity liquid electrolyte formulations — three top candidates were generated and experimentally validated.
problem_solved: Accelerates and focuses electrolyte discovery by overcoming slow, combinatorial experimental screening and the disconnect between prediction and generation in materials design.
method: Train a forward model to predict electrolyte properties (e.g., ionic conductivity) from formulation composition and conditions.
Use an inverse generative approach (latent-space optimization / conditional generator) to propose candidate formulations optimized for predicted performance.
Experimentally validate top-ranked candidates and close the loop to refine models.
impact: Provides a practical blueprint for integrating predictive and generative ML to speed materials discovery and increase experimental hit rates — valuable for ML practitioners building closed-loop design and discovery systems.
visual_elements: Pipeline diagram showing forward predictor → inverse generator → candidate selection → experimental validation loop
Bar chart comparing predicted vs. measured conductivities for baseline and generated candidates (highlighting the 3 validated hits)
Latent-space / embedding map with generated formulations and known compounds clustered to show exploration vs. exploitation
Iconographic representation of an electrolyte vial and conductivity meter to emphasize experimental validation
paper_title: A unified predictive and generative solution for liquid electrolyte formulation
paper_authors: Zhenze Yang, Yifan Wu, Xu Han, Ziqing Zhang, Haoen Lai
